issues.issue: Whether the new evidence (items a-k, except h) is admissible under s. 110(4)
issues.applicant_position: All ten items post-date rejection or were not reasonably available, so all should be admitted, including item (h).
issues.result_quote: I accept items (a), (b), (c), (d), (e), (f), (g), (i), (j), and (k) as new evidence in this appeal.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD was right to find the Appellant vague, unresponsive and evasive, so not credible
issues.applicant_position: The RPD's adverse inference is unparticularized; the transcript shows he answered clearly once instructed.
issues.result_quote: In my view, the RPD was wrong to draw an adverse credibility inference.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding no subjective fear because he did not claim in the United States
issues.applicant_position: He always meant to claim in Canada and only spent hours in the US; the RPD ignored his explanations.
issues.result_quote: the RPD was wrong to find that the Appellant lacks the requisite subjective fear

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding no subjective fear because he did not take Azerbaijani citizenship
issues.applicant_position: He tried to obtain citizenship, was told he was ineligible, and sought UNHCR protection; the RPD ignored this.
issues.result_quote: The Appellant's explanations for his lack of Azerbaijani citizenship were reasonable, and therefore the RPD's finding was incorrect.

issues.issue: Whether the Appellant faces more than a mere possibility of persecution in Turkey
issues.applicant_position: Hizmet profile and objective evidence on Turkish detentions and torture show a forward-looking risk in Turkey.
issues.result_quote: I therefore find that the Appellant faces more than a mere possibility of persecution in Turkey.

issues.issue: Whether the Appellant faces more than a mere possibility of persecution in Azerbaijan, including removal to Turkey
issues.applicant_position: Azerbaijan cooperates with Turkey's crackdown on Hizmet members; the RPD ignored renditions and his UNHCR letter.
issues.result_quote: I find that the Appellant faces more than a mere possibility of persecution in Azerbaijan.

issues.issue: Whether state protection or an internal flight alternative is available in either country
issues.applicant_position: The state is the agent of harm in both countries, so no protection or internal flight alternative exists.
issues.result_quote: I find that there is no state protection or internal flight alternative for him

issues.issue: Whether the RAD should substitute a determination that the Appellant is a Convention refugee
issues.applicant_position: Asked that the RAD find him a Convention refugee on the basis of his Hizmet profile.
issues.result_quote: substitute my own determination that the Appellant is a Convention refugee
